# CropForge

> Open-source crop simulation runtime. Built for computational agriculture.

CropForge is a Python-based runtime (Python 3.12+) developed in collaboration with ICAR-IARI Jharkhand. It enables researchers to simulate crop growth, yield, and environmental interactions under various conditions.

Created by: Saswat Sundar Rath

CropForge is open-source software licensed under the MIT License.
